content.text:
**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 11.1 renews automatically in **one-year** increments with a **mutual 30-day** non-renewal notice window — that meets our preferred position on both renewal term length and exit notice, and is comfortably clear of the 60-day fallback ceiling and the 90-day walk-away threshold.

Two minor gaps noted for the record only:
- No vendor reminder 60 days before renewal.
- No express CPI/3% uplift cap — though Exhibit B fixes MarketSite.net Service and maintenance/support fees for "Year 2-5, and beyond," so there is no uplift mechanic to cap.

The five-year initial term is an initial commitment rather than an automatic multi-year renewal, so it does not trigger the walk-away branch of this rule.
